blocks.content:
Act: 2013
Ombudsman of India
Chairperson + 8 Members
Tenure: 5 yrs / 70 yrs
Asset Disclosure Mandatory
Has Inquiry & Prosecution Wings

items: Extremely common question: The tenure of the Ombudsman chairperson and members is 5 years or 70 years of age, whichever is earlier.
Note the structural composition: Exactly 1 Chairperson + 8 Members.
Remember that asset disclosure is mandatory under the 2013 Act.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Ombudsman of India was constituted under the Act of 2013.
The body comprises a Chairperson and 8 Members.
The service tenure for members is fixed at 5 years or until attaining 70 years of age.
Mandatory asset disclosure is enforced under this framework.
The institution maintains separate Inquiry & Prosecution Wings for effective enforcement.
